note_en: Evidence-first macro monitor. Figures below were refreshed from the Federal Reserve, BLS and BEA; the live-market context is attributed to AP. Unknown expectations and unverified intraday moves are left unstated.
note_zh: 证据优先的宏观监测。下列数据已由美联储、美国劳工统计局与经济分析局刷新；实时市场背景引自美联社。无法核实的预期与盘中波动不作陈述。

hawkDoveCompass.rationale_en: The Fed held its target range at 3.50–3.75% on June 17 while describing inflation as elevated. May PCE inflation then printed 4.1% headline and 3.4% core year over year, so the verified evidence does not support declaring price stability restored.
hawkDoveCompass.rationale_zh: 美联储6月17日把目标利率区间维持在3.50%–3.75%，并称通胀仍然偏高；随后公布的5月PCE整体与核心同比分别为4.1%和3.4%。现有可核实证据不足以宣告价格稳定已经恢复。
hawkDoveCompass.method_en: Editorial score from the latest primary-source policy statement, inflation release and labor release. It is a qualitative risk label, not a rate forecast or investment advice.
hawkDoveCompass.method_zh: 依据最新可核实的政策声明、通胀与就业原始发布进行编辑评分；它是定性风险标签，不是利率预测或投资建议。

pillarSummary.en: Inflation remains above target, the Fed is holding, payroll growth is soft, AI-linked equities are dispersing sharply, and Middle East energy risk is still capable of moving the macro path. The correct posture is conditional, not confident.
pillarSummary.zh: 通胀仍高于目标，美联储维持利率，就业增长偏弱，AI相关股票分化明显，中东能源风险仍可能改变宏观路径。此时应保持条件式判断，而不是过度自信。

pillars.read_en: BEA reported May PCE prices up 0.4% month over month and 4.1% year over year; excluding food and energy, prices rose 0.3% monthly and 3.4% yearly. Those are the latest primary-source PCE figures verified in this refresh.
pillars.read_zh: 美国经济分析局公布：5月PCE物价环比上涨0.4%、同比上涨4.1%；剔除食品与能源后，环比与同比分别上涨0.3%和3.4%。这是本次刷新所核实的最新PCE原始数据。

pillars.read_en: The June 17 FOMC statement kept the federal-funds target range unchanged and said economic activity remained solid while inflation was elevated. The statement also flagged uncertainty tied to Middle East developments and energy prices.
pillars.read_zh: 6月17日FOMC声明维持联邦基金利率目标区间不变，称经济活动依然稳健、通胀仍然偏高，并指出中东局势与能源价格带来不确定性。

pillars.status_en: AI SPENDING FACES A REVENUE TEST
pillars.read_en: AMD published fiscal second-quarter results on August 4. AP's August 5 market report described a broader investor focus on whether heavy AI spending converts into revenue. This monitor does not infer guidance beyond the cited releases.
pillars.read_zh: AMD于8月4日发布第二财季业绩。美联社8月5日的市场报道显示，投资者正更广泛地审视巨额AI投入能否转化为收入。本监测不在已引用发布之外推断公司指引。

pillars.status_en: DISPERSION, NOT A UNIFORM AI BID
pillars.read_en: The latest completed-session quotes verified by the site showed NVDA higher while AMD was lower. That divergence is more informative than treating the semiconductor complex as one trade; no unverified premarket prices are mixed into this reading.
pillars.read_zh: 本站核实的最近完整交易日行情显示，英伟达上涨而AMD下跌。这种分化比把整个半导体板块视为单一交易更有信息量；本判断没有混入未经核实的盘前价格。

pillars.read_en: AP's August 6 market update linked mixed US futures to renewed Iran uncertainty and incoming economic data. The transmission channel is energy to inflation to the policy path; the direction and size of the next move remain uncertain.
pillars.read_zh: 美联社8月6日的市场更新把美股期货分化与伊朗局势再度不确定、关键经济数据临近联系起来。传导链条是能源、通胀再到政策路径；下一步方向与幅度仍不确定。

before.en: Policy entered the meeting with inflation still above target and uncertainty around energy and the Middle East.
before.zh: 会议召开前，通胀仍高于目标，能源与中东局势的不确定性持续存在。

print.en: The Committee kept the target range at 3.50–3.75%, described activity as solid and inflation as elevated.
print.zh: 委员会把目标区间维持在3.50%–3.75%，称经济活动稳健、通胀偏高。

repricing.en: The statement supports a data-dependent hold; it does not by itself establish the timing of the next move.
repricing.zh: 声明支持依赖数据的维持立场，但本身不能确定下一次调整的时间。

equityReaction.en: No market move is attributed here because this refresh did not verify a clean event-window price series.
equityReaction.zh: 本次刷新未核实干净的事件窗口价格序列，因此不在此归因市场波动。

verdict.en: Hawkish lean: the range was unchanged while the inflation diagnosis remained elevated. Not investment advice.
verdict.zh: 偏鹰：利率区间不变，而通胀判断仍为偏高。非投资建议。

before.en: The policy question was whether inflation was moving durably back toward target.
before.zh: 政策核心问题是通胀是否正持续回落至目标。

print.en: Headline PCE rose 0.4% monthly and 4.1% yearly; core PCE rose 0.3% monthly and 3.4% yearly.
print.zh: 整体PCE环比上涨0.4%、同比上涨4.1%；核心PCE环比上涨0.3%、同比上涨3.4%。

repricing.en: Above-target inflation keeps the easing threshold high, but no market-implied probability is asserted without a verified source.
repricing.zh: 高于目标的通胀提高了宽松门槛；在没有核实来源时，不陈述市场隐含概率。

equityReaction.en: No causal equity reaction is assigned in the absence of a verified event study.
equityReaction.zh: 在没有核实事件研究的情况下，不对股市反应作因果归因。

verdict.en: Price stability is not yet demonstrated by this release. Not investment advice.
verdict.zh: 这份数据尚不足以证明价格稳定已经实现。非投资建议。

before.en: Labor resilience was the counterweight to above-target inflation.
before.zh: 劳动力市场韧性此前是高通胀的主要制衡因素。

print.en: BLS reported nonfarm payrolls up 57,000 and labor-force participation at 61.5%; leisure and hospitality employment fell by 61,000.
print.zh: 美国劳工统计局公布非农就业增加5.7万人，劳动参与率为61.5%；休闲与酒店业就业减少6.1万人。

repricing.en: The softer employment signal pushes against the inflation signal, reinforcing meeting-by-meeting policy dependence.
repricing.zh: 偏弱的就业信号与通胀信号相互抵消，进一步强化逐次会议、依赖数据的政策路径。

equityReaction.en: No single equity move is attributed to the release in this evidence set.
equityReaction.zh: 本证据集中不把任何单一股市波动归因于该数据。

verdict.en: Growth risk increased, but one release does not establish a recession trend. Not investment advice.
verdict.zh: 增长风险上升，但单份数据不能确立衰退趋势。非投资建议。

name.en: Futures Mixed as Iran Risk Returns
name.zh: 伊朗风险再起，美股期货分化

before.en: US stocks had been trading near records while investors tested the revenue return on AI spending.
before.zh: 此前美股接近纪录高位，投资者正检验AI投入能否带来相应收入回报。

print.en: AP reported mixed US futures on August 6 amid renewed Iran uncertainty and attention to incoming economic data.
print.zh: 美联社8月6日报道，在伊朗局势不确定性再起、经济数据临近的背景下，美股期货走势分化。

repricing.en: The risk channel runs through energy and inflation; its magnitude cannot be inferred from headlines alone.
repricing.zh: 风险通过能源与通胀传导；仅凭标题无法推断其幅度。

equityReaction.en: This item records the reported setup, not a forecast of the cash-session close.
equityReaction.zh: 本条只记录已报道的市场背景，不预测现货市场收盘。

verdict.en: Treat geopolitics as a live scenario variable, not a deterministic trade. Not investment advice.
verdict.zh: 应把地缘局势视为实时情景变量，而非确定性交易信号。非投资建议。
